title: Music City Condo: Pool, Walk Broadway Gulch
description:
Beautifully decorated and  centrally located. Great building with Heated Pool (Open seasonally) Walking distance to all major attractions. Walk to the Gulch or Downtown  Honkytonks on  Broadway, Music row and  midtown. Views of Downtown from Balcony.  Scooter rentals and joyride tuk tuks  right next door. Amazing local Restaurants.
Security on premises ,  Parking in covered garage . Free Street Parking also available right behind the building. Great convenient location( permit	 active

The space
Brand New 1 bedroom unit in New Building with Great amenities. King Memory Foam Mattress, Queen sofa bed, WIFI, Record Player,  Records, Automatic Blinds, Bluetooth music Speaker, ac, heat, Fully stocked kitchen,Two Roku TVs  Great Balcony with gulch views, bluetooth music player, fitness center and pool .This urban escape is walking distance to  the city’s incredible music scene, fantastic dining, local shopping, and nightlife hotspots. Luxe amenities include a beautifully landscaped courtyard, a fitness center, and a seasonal pool in the heart of the building. Parking for one car and free street parking , Joyride Golf Carts  next door (free ride service app )

Guest access
Entire 1 /1 Condo, fitness center, heated pool (pool closed in winter), Parking Garage

Other things to note
Parking for one car  inside garage. Very large trucks may need to park along street in front or the rear of building.  Street parking is free :)
